d: Charcoal grey hair, shoulder-length with straight bangs and side-locks, frames a youthful face with sharp, ruby-red eyes. The build is slender and athletic, dressed in a teal-blue military-style jacket with a white ruffled cravat, matching short skirt, and thigh-high charcoal stockings with red-soled black shoes. Heavy grey mechanical rigging with multiple gun turrets and silver barrels is attached to the back and waist, complemented by a teal-blue peaked cap with a red band.
